lead.headline: High Point stays perfect and Radford climbs to second
lead.deck: The Panthers are 7-0 and 50th in our model. The rest of the league went 4-14 this week, and Radford's road win at Chattanooga was the best of it.
body: High Point beat Duquesne 75-70 on Tuesday and is 7-0, the only unbeaten record in the Big South. Our model has the Panthers 50th nationally at plus-16.5 points per 100 possessions. The next-best team in the league, Radford, sits 200th at minus-3.3. That is a gap of nearly 20 points per 100, which is less a race than a weather report.

Radford made the week's biggest move in the power rankings, from fifth to second. The Highlanders went to Chattanooga as 7.5-point underdogs on Saturday and won 73-65. Mathieu Grujicic scored 23, and Frederik Erichsen had 17 points, nine rebounds and five assists. On Friday they lost 64-62 at American, a 6.5-point favorite, and covered anyway. Two road games, one win, two covers.

Charleston Southern had the upset of the week. The Buccaneers lost 69-64 at Mercer and 82-58 at James Madison, then went to ETSU on Friday as 10-point underdogs and won 76-67. Anthony Ruffolo scored 27 and Alex Harper added 18 points, five rebounds and five assists.

Longwood slid from second to third after two road losses: 74-68 at ETSU, where MJ Williams scored 23, and 93-58 at George Mason. UNC Asheville fell from fourth to sixth. The Bulldogs covered at Samford as 10.5-point underdogs in an 80-77 loss, then lost 97-61 at Florida State.

The league went 5-14. Besides the three wins above, Presbyterian beat Carolina Christian 123-46 and USC Upstate beat Southern Wesleyan 87-78 behind 27 points and 10 rebounds from Miles Webb. Winthrop is still 0-7, but the Eagles rose from sixth to fifth in the rankings, which tells you how close the bottom of this league is.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three games worth your week
body: **George Mason at High Point, Wednesday, 7 p.m.** No line yet. George Mason beat Longwood by 35 on Wednesday. A visit from a team that just won by 35 is the cleanest test yet of whether that 50th-place rating is real.
**The Citadel at High Point, Saturday, 2 p.m.** High Point is favored by 26.5. The Citadel beat USC Upstate 72-54 on Wednesday, so the Bulldogs arrive with a pulse.

**North Carolina Central at Gardner-Webb, Saturday, 1 p.m. on ESPN+.** Gardner-Webb is favored by 1.5, and our model likes North Carolina Central by 4.5. The total is 137.5. The Runnin' Bulldogs are 1-6 and 359th in our model, so the books are giving them more credit than we are.

notes.headline: Keshawn Fisher went for 31
notes.body: Winthrop's guard scored 31 in a 91-86 loss at Wofford, where the Eagles covered as 6.5-point underdogs. Two days later he added 22 at Illinois.

notes.headline: Gardner-Webb keeps it close, then doesn't
notes.body: The Runnin' Bulldogs lost 71-68 at VMI as 8.5-point underdogs, with 20 from Seth Brown and 17 points and eight rebounds from Mikhali Pocknett. Then they lost 91-65 at Bowling Green.

notes.headline: Presbyterian hangs 123
notes.body: The Blue Hose beat Carolina Christian 123-46 on Tuesday, three days after losing 97-69 at Tennessee Tech. Jaylen Peterson scored 21 in Cookeville and 16 at home.

notes.headline: Circle it: George Mason at High Point
notes.body: Wednesday, Dec. 2, 7 p.m. ET. No line posted yet. The unbeaten Panthers get a George Mason team that just beat Longwood 93-58.
